_purpose: Measured volume baseline for the NETWORK_CONNECT / NETWORK_SEND producers. Reproduce with scripts/spikes/network-noise-measure.sh; the E2E contract is scripts/spikes/network-e2e.sh. dropped_events is parsed from the PROCESS_RINGBUF_STATS line on stderr; the script fails if that line is absent, so 0 is an observation, not a default.
method: process -m 2 -c python3, transient systemd unit issuing N TCP connects + N UDP sendto to 127.0.0.1

contract.one_syscall_one_event: an AF_INET connect(2) emits exactly one NETWORK_CONNECT; an AF_INET sendto(2) with a destination emits exactly one NETWORK_SEND
contract.addrlen: a sockaddr shorter than its family's struct (16 bytes for AF_INET, 24 for AF_INET6) is dropped rather than decoded; sendto(..., addr, 0) uses the connected peer and reports no destination
contract.af_inet6: decoded to host/port like AF_INET; the address is rendered canonically (e.g. ::1). No placeholder is ever emitted.
contract.scope: userspace PID tracking (same rule as file operations): mode 2 reports only tracked matching PIDs and their descendants

budget.note: The 8117 events/s figure is the achieved rate for a tight 200-connect burst, not a limit. The gate is amplification (events per syscall) and ring-buffer loss, both of which are independent of workload size.
